title: Common definitions of the Txori Kantua MQTT v1 contracts
description: The txori-kantua.invalid domain is an identifier, not an address that can be downloaded. The .invalid TLD is reserved by RFC 2606 precisely so that no client tries to resolve it. The $ref are resolved locally from contracts/.

schemaVersion.title: Contract version
schemaVersion.description: Major.minor version of the contract. The major matches the topic version (v1). A consumer rejects an unknown major and logs it, but does not stop.

eventId.title: Logical observation identifier
eventId.description: UUID generated ONCE per observation. It is kept identical on every retry: generating it again turns a resend into a false observation.

stationId.title: Logical station identifier
stationId.description: Stable, non-geographic name. It cannot contain coordinates or an address. It must match the station_id segment of the topic.

timestampUtc.title: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC
timestampUtc.description: Always with a Z suffix: offsets are not accepted, so that comparing two timestamps does not depend on interpreting a time zone. Up to nanoseconds are accepted, but storage truncates to milliseconds (ADR 0003). Second 60 is not accepted: an inserted leap second cannot be represented in Python date types and adds nothing to this system.

serviceName.title: Service name
serviceName.description: Identifies a station process in the availability topics and in the health map.
